queue.what: Shenzhen-based cross-border e-commerce parcel consolidator with direct lines and overseas warehouses in the U.S., typically handing parcels to USPS for final delivery.
Dubai-based courier and logistics group that owns U.S.-headquartered package-forwarding platform MyUS for cross-border e-commerce.
U.S.-headquartered cross-border package-forwarding platform, bought by Aramex for about $265M, that ships parcels from U.S., UK and China retailers to international customers.
International shipping provider offering Global Direct Entry, which injects cross-border parcels into the USPS network for final delivery in the U.S.
